stealth-vpn.description: De-branded full-featured VPN policy (EXCEPT OAuth2/deep-link which are excluded at source). Forbids Lantern brand identifiers only; 'lantern'/'getlantern' are case-insensitive substrings that catch all brand variants (lantern.io, lantern://, etc.) with zero generic-token false-positives. Login/payment/VPN surfaces intentionally retained. Does NOT extend the strict stealth base mode.

allowlist.reason: ICE credential type constant from pion/webrtc/v4::iceCredentialTypeOauthStr (RFC 7635 OAuth-based STUN/TURN access). Packed with srflx/prflx/relay/code/audio/video/offer/ufrag SDP constants. Dep chain: backend -> radiance/servers -> broflake/clientcore -> pion/webrtc/v4. Verified go mod why.

Proto wire-format field name 'stripeCustomerID' in LoginResponse_UserData_SubscriptionData (account/protos/auth.pb.go). Part of auth/login API response schema returned by the Lantern backend; not a payment entry point or SDK reference. No Stripe Go dep in go.mod/go.sum. Payment method symbols (NewStripeSubscription, StripeBillingPortalURL) are source-removed by //go:build !stealth_novpn on subscription.go.

Proto source file descriptor path 'api/protos/auth.proto' embedded by protoc-gen-go in account/protos/auth.pb.go (standard protobuf reflection metadata). Not the lantern://auth deep-link; that string is in account/oauth.go which is tagged //go:build !stealth_novpn and absent from this binary.
